proposed_capability: P00 governance + P01 harness + P95 camera-first world-object targeting: prefer framing a visible, nonoccluded, large enough world target in a safe viewport interior before any click plan. Compose with existing camera_traverse, host_stack and host_listener; require fresh host capture matching the current turn after each camera change; never blind-click or blind-pan. Trifecta P08 local live proof, P82 offline falsifiers, P07 bounded implementation/main integration.
player_save_control_impact: Read-only bounded framing recommendations for explicitly identified world targets. No SendInput, game launch, save mutation, external camera daemon or automatic loop; must preserve existing idle/foreground/save/scene/permission authority. No target click when observation is missing, stale, small, edge-clipped or occluded.
expected_outcome: World-target framing must precede click readiness. The host suggests bounded camera pan/zoom from the existing owner, captures/reobserves and parks inside the viewport, then recomputes eligibility; only an independently admitted runtime adapter could effect a click. UI-chrome fixed targets are unaffected.
negative_tests: Stale capture or target ID cannot authorize click readiness
Missing host observation cannot authorize click readiness
Target off screen, occluded or too small requires camera reframe
Camera reframe suggestions are bounded and terminate with safe rest
Attempts exhaustion returns a manual review gate, not infinite pan
Player-owned work and viewport anomalies continue to outrank target planning
Already framed clear target avoids unnecessary camera moves
rollback_path: Revert feature PR; no live game, save, installation, credential or background process touched.
unresolved_unknowns: Native Sims camera motion and target detection must be calibrated on exact build with P08; offline recommendation not proof of a live click.
